text:
Type: walnut veneer sideboard
Use: storing tableware, linens or media, a surface for lamps and decor; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: walnut veneer with a fine vertical grain, solid wood legs and base frame
Colors: medium warm walnut brown
Shape: long low cabinet with a row of flush doors, set on a slim wooden base with four square legs and a long stretcher, clean edges, substantial yet lifted
Feel: warm, refined, calm, timeless
Goes with: cream or white walls, brass lamps, green plants, wool rugs; mid-century modern or Scandinavian dining and living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: The sideboard in walnut veneer and solid ash brings a warm, natural feeling to your room.
